app.gui_missing:
The desktop app needs Flet, which is not installed.
Install it with:  pipx install 'pdf-tool-cli[gui]'
For the command line use:  pdf-tool --help
cli.description: Local PDF tools: nothing leaves your computer.
cli.error.missing_secret: Missing {name}: pass it with {flag} or the {env} variable
cli.error.output_dir_missing: The output folder does not exist: {path}
cli.help.lang: Language of the messages ({languages}). Default: PDFTOOL_LANG or the system language.
cli.help.secret: {help} Read from the first line of stdin (or from the {env} variable).
cli.validation.greater_than_equal: must be greater than or equal to {ge}
cli.validation.less_than_equal: must be less than or equal to {le}
core.error.file_not_found: The file was not found. Did you move or delete it? Choose it again.
core.error.generic: The file could not be processed. It may be damaged or password-protected (you can remove the password with «Protect PDF»).
core.error.permission: No permission to read or save the file. Close it if it is open, or choose another folder in «Save to».
core.naming.forbidden_chars: Invalid output name: it cannot contain / \ : ? | < > * "
core.naming.reserved: Invalid output name: «{name}» is reserved by Windows.
param.output_dir: Output folder (default: next to the original).
tool.compress.description: Reduce the size of one or more PDFs to a target in MB.
tool.compress.item.missed_max: {result} (target not reached; saved the smallest possible version)
tool.compress.item.missed_preserve: {result} (target not reached; saved the smallest version with the content preserved)
tool.compress.name: Compress PDF
tool.compress.param.mode.max: the smallest possible file (some pages may lose selectable text)
tool.compress.ui.error.target: Enter a size greater than 0, for example 5 or 2.5.
tool.compress.ui.help:
Reduce as much as possible: looks for the smallest possible file. Some pages may lose selectable text.

Keep text and links: keeps search, copy/paste, links and annotations when possible, although the file may be larger.
tool.compress.warning.rasterized: Some pages were turned into images: selectable text, links or annotations may have been lost. If you need them, use «Keep text and links».
tool.images2pdf.description: Create one PDF per image (JPG or PNG).
tool.images2pdf.error.too_big: The image is too large ({width}×{height} px). Reduce it before converting it.
tool.images2pdf.name: Images to PDF
tool.merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose.
tool.merge.name: Merge PDFs
tool.merge.param.output_name: Name of the merged PDF, without extension (default: automatic).
tool.protect.description: Add or remove the password of one or more PDFs.
tool.protect.error.already: The PDF is already protected; remove its password first.
tool.protect.name: Protect PDF
tool.protect.ui.keep_safe: Keep it safe: without it you will not be able to open the PDF.
tool.split.description: Split a PDF into several, by ranges or by pages.
tool.split.error.bad_page: «{text}» is not a valid page number. Use, for example, 1-3, 5
tool.split.error.bad_range: «{token}» is not a valid range. Use, for example, 1-3, 5

tool.split.error.out_of_bounds.one: The range {start}-{end} exceeds the total of {count} page
tool.split.error.out_of_bounds.other: The range {start}-{end} exceeds the total of {count} pages

tool.split.error.reversed: The range «{token}» is backwards: write the lower page first.
tool.split.name: Split PDF
tool.split.ui.error.every: Enter a number of pages greater than 0.
tool.split.ui.help:
How to write ranges:
  1-3    →  pages 1 to 3
  5      →  only page 5
  8-     →  from page 8 to the end
  -4     →  from the start to page 4
Separate several ranges with commas:
  1-3, 5, 8-
tool.watermark.description: Repeat a text diagonally across every page.
tool.watermark.name: Watermark
tool.watermark.param.color: RGB color, each value from 0 to 1.
tool.watermark.ui.error.params: Check the text, size and opacity.
